meta.indexabilityRule: A page is INDEXABLE only if live inventory >= requiredInventory AND inventory is genuinely relevant. Otherwise the page renders with noindex (still browsable) and is excluded from the sitemap. Pages with requiredInventory=0 are always indexable.
meta.priceRule: Never display a price that is not backed by live inventory. The engine only renders 'from ₹X' when computed from room.pricePerNight > 1. Otherwise it renders 'prices vary by dates' wording.
meta.contentRule: Every indexable page must have unique content: intro, sections, FAQs, location/transport info, related pages and tour links. No doorway pages.

hub.h1: Hotels in Delhi — Compare, Choose & Book with Instant Confirmation
hub.introduction: Delhi is India's most-visited capital gateway — and the single largest hotel market in the country. Whether you are landing at IGI Airport, arriving by train at New Delhi Railway Station, or here for business in Connaught Place, GetHotelStays gives you a live list of verified Delhi hotels with real availability. Right now {count} bookable properties in Delhi are shown on this page, with filters for area, price, star rating and amenities. Our 'Pay 12% Now' model means you confirm with a small deposit online and settle the balance at the hotel — ideal for international travellers who want a guaranteed room without paying the full amount upfront.

sections.h2: Best Areas to Stay in Delhi
sections.text: Delhi is a collection of distinct neighbourhoods. Mahipalpur and Aerocity sit next to IGI Airport for transit stays. Paharganj is the budget backpacker hub beside New Delhi Railway Station. Karol Bagh offers mid-range family hotels with the best street shopping. Connaught Place is the central business district. South Delhi (Hauz Khas, Saket, Greater Kailash, Lajpat Nagar) is upscale and trendy. Each area page on GetHotelStays lists only hotels that actually exist there — no filler listings.

The largest cluster of GHS Delhi inventory sits in Mahipalpur and Aerocity, 5–15 minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport. These properties specialise in early-morning and late-night flights: 24-hour front desk, airport shuttle or pickup, and flexible check-in. Filter the list below by 'Airport Shuttle' to see only properties with airport transfer.

sections.h2: Budget, Family & Luxury Hotels in Delhi
sections.text: Delhi hotels span every budget. The budget segment is strongest in Paharganj, Mahipalpur and Laxmi Nagar. Family-friendly properties with large rooms and attached dining are concentrated in Karol Bagh and South Delhi. Luxury 4–5 star stays cluster in Aerocity, Connaught Place and Chanakyapuri. Use the category links below to jump straight to the segment you need.

sections.h2: Pay 12% Now — Rest at the Hotel
sections.text: GetHotelStays' signature booking model: pay 12% online to lock in the room, settle the remaining 88% directly at the hotel in cash, UPI or card. No booking fees, instant email confirmation, and free cancellation on most Delhi properties up to 24–48 hours before check-in.
